name: Super Mario Bros.

rom.title: Super Mario Bros. (World) (No-Intro, NES 2.0 header)
rom.tasvideos_version: https://tasvideos.org/Games/1/Versions/View/68 (Super Mario Bros. (W) [!], GoodNES 3.23: the same game data, an iNES 1.0 header)
rom.note: Your own dump or copy; never in this repository. `sha1` is the SHA-1 of the whole file (header included), which the doctor checks; `md5` is the MD5 of the ROM's PRG and CHR data, header left out, which FCEUX reports (rom.gethash; src/ines.cpp, 2.6.6) and the plugin checks when the run starts.

memory.source: periwinkle9/smb-autosplitter (Zlib), SuperMarioBros.asl: worldNum 0x75F, levelNum 0x75C, operMode 0x770; its end of the run is worldNum >= 7 and operMode becoming 2 (the axe in 8-4). Measured in FCEUX 2.6.6 on 2026-09-23 while FCEUX played TAS 3728 itself: world 1-1 from frame 4, 2-1 at frame 7929, 3-1 at 17070, 8-4 at 64306, operMode 2 on the movie's last frame (67117).

goal: Beat the game: defeat Bowser at the end of World 8-4. Each world counts as a split.
controls: D-pad Left/Right to walk, Down to duck (as Super Mario), B to run and to throw fireballs, A to jump (hold longer to jump higher), Start to begin at the title screen and to pause.

tas.title: NES Super Mario Bros. "warpless" by HappyLee & Mars608 in 18:36.78

tas.sync: FCEUX 2.6.6 plays the movie itself in sync to the end: World 8-4 from frame 64306 and operMode 2 (the game's end) at frame 67117, the movie's last (measured 2026-09-23 21:49). The same input played through fceux-mcp's bridge, 600 frames a call, gives the same world, level, x position and operMode after every call (112 calls, 0 differences; win64, 2026-09-23 23:26).

bot.about: The mock replays the TAS's own input, frame by frame, through the same buttons the agent has, from power-on, with the movie's reset on frame 0; its goal is the game's end.
